title: Majority wrong on GSM-Hard: 4/6 agents endorse wrong answer — replicating Cost of Consensus

notes: 4 of 6 agents start endorsing the wrong math answer. 2 are unbiased.
This matches the setup in Cost of Consensus (majority wrong) and Conformity Dynamics (social pressure).
Compare: majority stays vs majority exits, memory vs chat, 1-wrong vs 4-wrong.
If the 2 unbiased agents fold to the majority, we've replicated the conformity finding in our testbed.
If they don't, Claude is genuinely robust even to majority pressure.
